about: Game contains In-Game Purchases Over 70 awesome songs! All the best ones from the arcade in your home!
• The PS4® system version is packed full of what makes Taiko no Tatsujin great!
In Friend Session, register friends and family with a Sony Interactive Entertainment account as friends to play with them even when they're not nearby!
In Guest Session, play Taiko Mode with popular characters!
Feel like taking on players from all over the world? Then Ranked Match is for you! Get matched with players of a similar skill level win to raise your rank! Can you reach the top spot?!
You need a Sony  Interactive Entertainment account to play Friend Session and Ranked Match.
